title: Kamino’s Amazing Clone Factory
front_description: "Magnificent, aren't they?" observes Kamino Prime Minister Lama Su, standing on a balcony with his impressed visitor Obi-Wan Kenobi. Below them are thousands of clone troopers marching in formation, their faces covered by helmets. Obi-Wan is given a thorough tour of the clone center, an astonishing complex filled with mass-produced soldiers at every stage of human development.
back_description: Kurt Kaufman's concept of the fabulous clone factory on the planet Kamino.
